commit.message:
Copyright update and justify vm_direct_exit

- Copyright update on the test.
- Add a comment in handle_full_code_cache explaining why before_exit()/
  exit_globals() cannot be used here (no-safepoint scope on a compiler thread)
  and why vm_direct_exit(1) is sufficient for this diagnostic develop flag.

Make code heap sizes robust across page/allocation granularity (review: TobiHartmann)

Leave a 256 KB margin (a multiple of the 64 KB max allocation granularity)
between NonNMethodCodeHeapSize and ReservedCodeCacheSize so the profiled/
non-profiled (and hot) nmethod heaps always meet their platform minimum,
avoiding a startup 'Invalid code heap sizes' abort that would let the test
pass without exercising the exit path. Also assert the VM did not fail code
heap creation so the test can never silently no-op.

Make ExitOnFullCodeCacheTest platform-independent

Whether the code cache fills during the short startup run (and thus
whether the ExitOnFullCodeCache path is taken) depends on how much
compilation happens before the VM would exit, which varies by platform
(macOS/aarch64 and Windows did not overflow, so 'CodeCache:' was never
printed and the VM exited normally). Assert only the invariant that must
always hold -- the safepoint assertion must not fire and the VM must not
crash -- instead of a specific exit code or the code cache report.

Address review: use vm_direct_exit(1) instead of vm_exit(1), add jtreg regression test

vm_exit(1) still trips the 'Possible safepoint reached by thread that
does not allow it' assertion: it acquires Heap_lock with a safepoint
check while the compiler thread installing the nmethod holds VM-blocking
locks (Compile_lock, MethodCompileQueue_lock), so _no_safepoint_count > 0.
Setting the thread state to _thread_in_vm does not reset that counter.

vm_direct_exit(1) performs notify_vm_shutdown() + os::exit() without
acquiring any safepoint-checking lock, so it exits cleanly from the
no-safepoint context.

Add compiler/codecache/ExitOnFullCodeCacheTest.java, which deterministically
reproduces the failure with -Xcomp and a near-zero method code heap.

8376286: VM asserts with Possible safepoint reached by thread that does not allow it when running with -XX:+ExitOnFullCodeCache

Replace the manual before_exit() + exit_globals() + vm_direct_exit()
sequence with vm_exit() which correctly transitions the compiler
thread state to _thread_in_vm before initiating shutdown, allowing
it to safely acquire locks that may reach a safepoint.
